results.expected_answer: An accident must be a sudden, unexpected event causing injury that results in death within 90 days of the event.
results.evidence: An accident means a sudden, unexpected event causing injury that results in death within 90 days of the event.
results.llm_answer: An accidental death is recognized for the full benefit if it results from a sudden, unexpected event causing injury that leads to death within 90 days of the event. In such cases, the full $10,000 benefit is paid immediately, along with all premiums paid.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMPORTANT: There is a waiting period for full benefits.

IF DEATH OCCURS:

During Year 1 (before May 1, 2025):
  We pay 30% of face amount ($3,000) plus all premiums paid

During Year 2 (May 1, 2025 - April 30, 2026):
  We pay 70% of face amount ($7,000) plus all premiums paid

After Year 2 (on or after May 1, 2026):
  We pay the full benefit amount ($10,000)

at any time, we pay the full benefit amount immediately, plus all 
premiums paid.
